panels.title: Deep dive — heavy queries; prefer shorter time ranges (e.g. 1–3h)

panels.description: Average daily number of distinct outbound IPs per phone over the selected range. Value is unique IP count per phone per day, then averaged.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(phone_day_unique_ips), 1), 0) as value FROM (SELECT CAST(r.timestamp AS DATE) as day, r.proxy_id, COUNT(DISTINCT r.outbound_ip) as phone_day_unique_ips FROM proxy_requests r JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp) AND r.outbound_ip IS NOT NULL AND p.location IN ($location) AND CONCAT(p.name, ' [', p.device_id, ']') LIKE '${phone:raw}' AND (CASE WHEN UPPER(p.name) REGEXP '^S[0-9]+' THEN CONCAT('S', REGEXP_SUBSTR(p.name, '[0-9]+')) ELSE 'Unknown' END) LIKE '${server:raw}' GROUP BY CAST(r.timestamp AS DATE), r.proxy_id) daily

panels.title: Avg Unique IPs / Phone / Timerange

panels.description: Time-series by minute: unique_ips is distinct outbound IPs seen in that minute; active_phones is distinct phones with at least one request in that minute.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(r.timestamp, '1m'),
  COUNT(DISTINCT r.outbound_ip) as unique_ips,
  COUNT(DISTINCT r.proxy_id) as active_phones
FROM proxy_requests r
JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp)
  AND r.outbound_ip IS NOT NULL
  AND p.location IN ($location) AND CONCAT(p.name, ' [', p.device_id, ']') LIKE '${phone:raw}' AND (CASE WHEN UPPER(p.name) REGEXP '^S[0-9]+' THEN CONCAT('S', REGEXP_SUBSTR(p.name, '[0-9]+')) ELSE 'Unknown' END) LIKE '${server:raw}'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Unique IPs & Active Phones — Trend

panels.description: Per-phone reliability table grouped by relay server. uptime_pct is SUCCESS/total requests; active_days is number of distinct days with activity; avg_response_ms is average latency.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN UPPER(p.name) REGEXP '^S[0-9]+' THEN CONCAT('S', REGEXP_SUBSTR(p.name, '[0-9]+')) ELSE 'Unknown' END as server, CONCAT(p.name, ' [', p.device_id, ']') as phone, p.location, COUNT(*) as total_requests, COUNT(CASE WHEN r.status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) as successful, COUNT(CASE WHEN r.status != 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) as failed, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN r.status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) as uptime_pct, COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(r.timestamp)) as active_days, ROUND(AVG(r.response_time_ms), 0) as avg_response_ms FROM proxy_requests r JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp) AND p.location IN ($location) AND CONCAT(p.name, ' [', p.device_id, ']') LIKE '${phone:raw}' AND (CASE WHEN UPPER(p.name) REGEXP '^S[0-9]+' THEN CONCAT('S', REGEXP_SUBSTR(p.name, '[0-9]+')) ELSE 'Unknown' END) LIKE '${server:raw}' GROUP BY server, p.device_id, p.name, p.location ORDER BY server, uptime_pct DESC

panels.title: Phone Uptime per Server

panels.description: Per-phone traffic and performance metrics. success_rate_pct is SUCCESS/total; unique_ips is distinct outbound IPs; avg_download_mbps and avg_upload_mbps are average measured throughput.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CONCAT(p.name, ' [', p.device_id, ']') as phone, p.location, CASE WHEN UPPER(p.name) REGEXP '^S[0-9]+' THEN CONCAT('S', REGEXP_SUBSTR(p.name, '[0-9]+')) ELSE 'Unknown' END as server, COUNT(*) as total_requests, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN r.status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) as success_rate_pct, COUNT(CASE WHEN r.status != 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) as failed_requests, ROUND(AVG(r.response_time_ms), 0) as avg_response_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT r.outbound_ip) as unique_ips, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN r.download_speed_mbps > 0 THEN r.download_speed_mbps END), 2) as avg_download_mbps, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN r.upload_speed_mbps > 0 THEN r.upload_speed_mbps END), 2) as avg_upload_mbps, SUM(CASE WHEN r.ip_changed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as ip_rotations_detected FROM proxy_requests r JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp) AND p.location IN ($location) AND CONCAT(p.name, ' [', p.device_id, ']') LIKE '${phone:raw}' AND (CASE WHEN UPPER(p.name) REGEXP '^S[0-9]+' THEN CONCAT('S', REGEXP_SUBSTR(p.name, '[0-9]+')) ELSE 'Unknown' END) LIKE '${server:raw}' GROUP BY p.device_id, p.name, p.location, server ORDER BY total_requests DESC

panels.title: Traffic Stats per Phone

panels.description: For each phone, diversity_score_pct = distinct outbound IPs divided by total requests, shown as percent. Higher values indicate more IP variation.

targets.rawSql: SELECT p.name as phone, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT r.outbound_ip) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) as diversity_score_pct FROM proxy_requests r JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp) AND r.outbound_ip IS NOT NULL AND p.location IN ($location) AND CONCAT(p.name, ' [', p.device_id, ']') LIKE '${phone:raw}' AND (CASE WHEN UPPER(p.name) REGEXP '^S[0-9]+' THEN CONCAT('S', REGEXP_SUBSTR(p.name, '[0-9]+')) ELSE 'Unknown' END) LIKE '${server:raw}' GROUP BY p.device_id, p.name ORDER BY diversity_score_pct DESC

panels.title: IP Diversity Score per Phone (unique IPs / total requests %)

panels.description: Aggregates performance by hour of day (0-23) within selected range. success_rate_pct is hourly SUCCESS ratio; active_phones and unique_ips show concurrency and IP spread.

targets.rawSql: SELECT HOUR(r.timestamp) as hour_of_day, COUNT(*) as total_requests, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN r.status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) as success_rate_pct, ROUND(AVG(r.response_time_ms), 0) as avg_response_ms, COUNT(DISTINCT r.proxy_id) as active_phones, COUNT(DISTINCT r.outbound_ip) as unique_ips FROM proxy_requests r JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp) AND p.location IN ($location) AND CONCAT(p.name, ' [', p.device_id, ']') LIKE '${phone:raw}' AND (CASE WHEN UPPER(p.name) REGEXP '^S[0-9]+' THEN CONCAT('S', REGEXP_SUBSTR(p.name, '[0-9]+')) ELSE 'Unknown' END) LIKE '${server:raw}' GROUP BY HOUR(r.timestamp) ORDER BY hour_of_day

panels.title: Peak Hour Analysis (by Hour of Day)

panels.description: Lists outbound IPs used by more than one phone in the selected period. phones_sharing is distinct phone count sharing the same IP; total_occurrences is total request rows for that IP.

targets.rawSql: SELECT r.outbound_ip, COUNT(DISTINCT r.proxy_id) as phones_sharing, COUNT(*) as total_occurrences, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.name ORDER BY p.name SEPARATOR ', ') as phones, MIN(r.timestamp) as first_seen, MAX(r.timestamp) as last_seen FROM proxy_requests r JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp) AND r.outbound_ip IS NOT NULL AND p.location IN ($location) AND CONCAT(p.name, ' [', p.device_id, ']') LIKE '${phone:raw}' AND (CASE WHEN UPPER(p.name) REGEXP '^S[0-9]+' THEN CONCAT('S', REGEXP_SUBSTR(p.name, '[0-9]+')) ELSE 'Unknown' END) LIKE '${server:raw}' GROUP BY r.outbound_ip HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.proxy_id) > 1 ORDER BY phones_sharing DESC, total_occurrences DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: IPs Shared by Multiple Phones

panels.description: Phone ranking by uptime and IP breadth. uptime_pct is SUCCESS ratio; unique_ips and ip_diversity_pct indicate rotation variety; rotations_detected counts rows where ip_changed=1.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CONCAT(p.name, ' [', p.device_id, ']') as phone, CASE WHEN UPPER(p.name) REGEXP '^S[0-9]+' THEN CONCAT('S', REGEXP_SUBSTR(p.name, '[0-9]+')) ELSE 'Unknown' END as server, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN r.status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) as uptime_pct, COUNT(DISTINCT r.outbound_ip) as unique_ips, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT r.outbound_ip) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) as ip_diversity_pct, ROUND(AVG(r.response_time_ms), 0) as avg_response_ms, SUM(CASE WHEN r.ip_changed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as rotations_detected, p.stability_status, p.rotation_status FROM proxy_requests r JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp) AND p.location IN ($location) AND CONCAT(p.name, ' [', p.device_id, ']') LIKE '${phone:raw}' AND (CASE WHEN UPPER(p.name) REGEXP '^S[0-9]+' THEN CONCAT('S', REGEXP_SUBSTR(p.name, '[0-9]+')) ELSE 'Unknown' END) LIKE '${server:raw}' GROUP BY p.device_id, p.name, server, p.stability_status, p.rotation_status ORDER BY uptime_pct DESC, unique_ips DESC

panels.title: Phone Reliability Ranking

panels.description: Monthly aggregation by server. unique_ips is distinct outbound IPs in that month, active_phones is number of phones active, and uptime_pct is monthly SUCCESS ratio.

targets.rawSql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(r.timestamp, '%Y-%m') as month, CASE WHEN UPPER(p.name) REGEXP '^S[0-9]+' THEN CONCAT('S', REGEXP_SUBSTR(p.name, '[0-9]+')) ELSE 'Unknown' END as server, COUNT(DISTINCT r.outbound_ip) as unique_ips, COUNT(DISTINCT r.proxy_id) as active_phones, COUNT(*) as total_requests, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN r.status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) as uptime_pct FROM proxy_requests r JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp) AND r.outbound_ip IS NOT NULL AND p.location IN ($location) AND CONCAT(p.name, ' [', p.device_id, ']') LIKE '${phone:raw}' AND (CASE WHEN UPPER(p.name) REGEXP '^S[0-9]+' THEN CONCAT('S', REGEXP_SUBSTR(p.name, '[0-9]+')) ELSE 'Unknown' END) LIKE '${server:raw}' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(r.timestamp, '%Y-%m'), server ORDER BY month DESC, server LIMIT 200

panels.title: Monthly Unique IPs per Server

panels.description: Daily per-phone breakdown. unique_ips is distinct outbound IPs for the day; requests is total request count; uptime_pct is daily SUCCESS ratio; avg_response_ms is average latency.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CAST(r.timestamp AS DATE) as day, CONCAT(p.name, ' [', p.device_id, ']') as phone, CASE WHEN UPPER(p.name) REGEXP '^S[0-9]+' THEN CONCAT('S', REGEXP_SUBSTR(p.name, '[0-9]+')) ELSE 'Unknown' END as server, COUNT(DISTINCT r.outbound_ip) as unique_ips, COUNT(*) as requests, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN r.status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) as uptime_pct, ROUND(AVG(r.response_time_ms), 0) as avg_response_ms FROM proxy_requests r JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp) AND r.outbound_ip IS NOT NULL AND p.location IN ($location) AND CONCAT(p.name, ' [', p.device_id, ']') LIKE '${phone:raw}' AND (CASE WHEN UPPER(p.name) REGEXP '^S[0-9]+' THEN CONCAT('S', REGEXP_SUBSTR(p.name, '[0-9]+')) ELSE 'Unknown' END) LIKE '${server:raw}' GROUP BY CAST(r.timestamp AS DATE), p.device_id, p.name, server ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 300

panels.title: Unique IPs per Phone per Day

panels.description: Breakdown of non-success statuses in selected time range with share percentage of all failures.

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.status, s.failed_requests, ROUND(s.failed_requests * 100.0 / NULLIF(t.total_failed, 0), 2) as failure_pct FROM (SELECT r.status, COUNT(*) as failed_requests FROM proxy_requests r JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp) AND p.location IN ($location) AND CONCAT(p.name, ' [', p.device_id, ']') LIKE '${phone:raw}' AND (CASE WHEN UPPER(p.name) REGEXP '^S[0-9]+' THEN CONCAT('S', REGEXP_SUBSTR(p.name, '[0-9]+')) ELSE 'Unknown' END) LIKE '${server:raw}' AND r.status != 'SUCCESS' AND r.status LIKE '${status:raw}' GROUP BY r.status) s CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) as total_failed FROM proxy_requests r JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp) AND p.location IN ($location) AND CONCAT(p.name, ' [', p.device_id, ']') LIKE '${phone:raw}' AND (CASE WHEN UPPER(p.name) REGEXP '^S[0-9]+' THEN CONCAT('S', REGEXP_SUBSTR(p.name, '[0-9]+')) ELSE 'Unknown' END) LIKE '${server:raw}' AND r.status != 'SUCCESS' AND r.status LIKE '${status:raw}') t ORDER BY s.failed_requests DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Failure Reasons Breakdown

panels.description: 5-minute IP rotation velocity. rotations_per_active_phone highlights how aggressively IPs change per active phone.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(r.timestamp, '5m'), SUM(CASE WHEN r.ip_changed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as ip_rotations, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN r.ip_changed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT r.proxy_id), 0), 2) as rotations_per_active_phone FROM proxy_requests r JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp) AND p.location IN ($location) AND CONCAT(p.name, ' [', p.device_id, ']') LIKE '${phone:raw}' AND (CASE WHEN UPPER(p.name) REGEXP '^S[0-9]+' THEN CONCAT('S', REGEXP_SUBSTR(p.name, '[0-9]+')) ELSE 'Unknown' END) LIKE '${server:raw}' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: IP Rotation Velocity — Trend

panels.description: Tail latency by relay server using p95/p99 over selected range.

targets.rawSql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT CASE WHEN UPPER(p.name) REGEXP '^S[0-9]+' THEN CONCAT('S', REGEXP_SUBSTR(p.name, '[0-9]+')) ELSE 'Unknown' END as server, r.response_time_ms, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN UPPER(p.name) REGEXP '^S[0-9]+' THEN CONCAT('S', REGEXP_SUBSTR(p.name, '[0-9]+')) ELSE 'Unknown' END ORDER BY r.response_time_ms) as rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN UPPER(p.name) REGEXP '^S[0-9]+' THEN CONCAT('S', REGEXP_SUBSTR(p.name, '[0-9]+')) ELSE 'Unknown' END) as cnt FROM proxy_requests r JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp) AND p.location IN ($location) AND CONCAT(p.name, ' [', p.device_id, ']') LIKE '${phone:raw}' AND (CASE WHEN UPPER(p.name) REGEXP '^S[0-9]+' THEN CONCAT('S', REGEXP_SUBSTR(p.name, '[0-9]+')) ELSE 'Unknown' END) LIKE '${server:raw}' AND r.response_time_ms IS NOT NULL) SELECT server, MIN(cnt) as samples, MAX(CASE WHEN rn >= FLOOR(cnt * 0.95) THEN response_time_ms END) as p95_ms, MAX(CASE WHEN rn >= FLOOR(cnt * 0.99) THEN response_time_ms END) as p99_ms FROM ranked GROUP BY server ORDER BY p99_ms DESC

panels.title: P95/P99 Latency by Server

panels.description: Tail latency by phone for top active phones in selected range.

targets.rawSql: WITH top_phones AS (SELECT r.proxy_id FROM proxy_requests r JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp) AND p.location IN ($location) AND (CASE WHEN UPPER(p.name) REGEXP '^S[0-9]+' THEN CONCAT('S', REGEXP_SUBSTR(p.name, '[0-9]+')) ELSE 'Unknown' END) LIKE '${server:raw}' AND CONCAT(p.name, ' [', p.device_id, ']') LIKE '${phone:raw}' GROUP BY r.proxy_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 40), ranked AS (SELECT r.proxy_id, CONCAT(p.name, ' [', p.device_id, ']') as phone, r.response_time_ms, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.proxy_id ORDER BY r.response_time_ms) as rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY r.proxy_id) as cnt FROM proxy_requests r JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id JOIN top_phones tp ON tp.proxy_id = r.proxy_id WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp) AND p.location IN ($location) AND (CASE WHEN UPPER(p.name) REGEXP '^S[0-9]+' THEN CONCAT('S', REGEXP_SUBSTR(p.name, '[0-9]+')) ELSE 'Unknown' END) LIKE '${server:raw}' AND CONCAT(p.name, ' [', p.device_id, ']') LIKE '${phone:raw}' AND r.response_time_ms IS NOT NULL) SELECT phone, MIN(cnt) as samples, MAX(CASE WHEN rn >= FLOOR(cnt * 0.95) THEN response_time_ms END) as p95_ms, MAX(CASE WHEN rn >= FLOOR(cnt * 0.99) THEN response_time_ms END) as p99_ms FROM ranked GROUP BY proxy_id, phone ORDER BY p99_ms DESC LIMIT 30

panels.title: P95/P99 Latency by Phone

panels.description: IP churn by phone: total rotations and normalized rates per active hour/day.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CONCAT(p.name, ' [', p.device_id, ']') as phone, COUNT(*) as total_requests, SUM(CASE WHEN r.ip_changed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as ip_rotations, COUNT(DISTINCT DATE_FORMAT(r.timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00')) as active_hours, COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(r.timestamp AS DATE)) as active_days, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN r.ip_changed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT DATE_FORMAT(r.timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00')), 0), 2) as rotations_per_active_hour, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN r.ip_changed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(r.timestamp AS DATE)), 0), 2) as rotations_per_active_day FROM proxy_requests r JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp) AND p.location IN ($location) AND CONCAT(p.name, ' [', p.device_id, ']') LIKE '${phone:raw}' AND (CASE WHEN UPPER(p.name) REGEXP '^S[0-9]+' THEN CONCAT('S', REGEXP_SUBSTR(p.name, '[0-9]+')) ELSE 'Unknown' END) LIKE '${server:raw}' GROUP BY p.device_id, p.name ORDER BY rotations_per_active_hour DESC, total_requests DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: IP Churn Velocity by Phone (Hour/Day)

panels.description: Largest inactivity gap per phone within selected range using adjacent request timestamps.

targets.rawSql: WITH gaps AS (SELECT r.proxy_id, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, LAG(r.timestamp) OVER (PARTITION BY r.proxy_id ORDER BY r.timestamp), r.timestamp) as gap_min FROM proxy_requests r JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp) AND p.location IN ($location) AND CONCAT(p.name, ' [', p.device_id, ']') LIKE '${phone:raw}' AND (CASE WHEN UPPER(p.name) REGEXP '^S[0-9]+' THEN CONCAT('S', REGEXP_SUBSTR(p.name, '[0-9]+')) ELSE 'Unknown' END) LIKE '${server:raw}') SELECT CONCAT(p.name, ' [', p.device_id, ']') as phone, COUNT(*) as total_requests, ROUND(COALESCE(MAX(g.gap_min), 0), 0) as max_gap_minutes FROM proxy_requests r JOIN proxies p ON r.proxy_id = p.device_id LEFT JOIN gaps g ON g.proxy_id = r.proxy_id WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp) AND p.location IN ($location) AND CONCAT(p.name, ' [', p.device_id, ']') LIKE '${phone:raw}' AND (CASE WHEN UPPER(p.name) REGEXP '^S[0-9]+' THEN CONCAT('S', REGEXP_SUBSTR(p.name, '[0-9]+')) ELSE 'Unknown' END) LIKE '${server:raw}' GROUP BY p.device_id, p.name ORDER BY max_gap_minutes DESC, total_requests DESC LIMIT 50
